<a id="architecture"></a>

## Architecture

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| principles | Hexagonal, functional core / imperative shell, constructor injection, no clock or ambient lookup in core/sdk (now_ms is injected). core::status owns the SessionStatus DTOs and two ports: SessionStatusApi (explicit target -&gt; facts) and TargetResolver (pij id / tmux pane / explicit -&gt; target). The SDK StatusService implements SessionStatusApi over Plan 028 PrepBinding {fold, loader} + fold_source; it never calls pij, tmux or processes. Target resolution (pij list + liveness, tmux pane -&gt; child harness process -&gt; harness session record) is I/O in loader-query, used by the CLI path only. The CLI maps argv to queries and renders; no status semantics. crates/app is the only composition root. Status derivation is a pure function of SessionFacts + accumulated call/turn rows + now_ms. |
| composition_root | crates/app/src/main.rs dispatches `sessions status`; crates/app/src/status.rs (new) builds StatusService from the Plan 028 bindings table (crates/app/src/prep.rs) and the loader-query StatusTargetResolver. Nothing else constructs concrete loaders, folds or resolvers. |
| contracts | core::status (crates/core/src/status.rs), STATUS_SCHEMA_VERSION = 1. All DTOs serde (Serialize + Deserialize); timestamps are i64 epoch ms; unknown facts are None AND named in SessionStatus.unknown; a harness never reports 0 for an unrecorded fact., Basis = native \| derived \| table \| mtime_fallback (snake_case). Fact&lt;T&gt; {value: T, basis: Basis}. Table-derived values carry the table version (context.window_table = "model-windows@1")., StatusTarget {harness: String (adapter id, e.g. "claude-code"), session_id: String, transcript: Option&lt;PathBuf&gt;}. StatusQuery = Target(StatusTarget) \| Pij(String) \| Pane(String). ResolveBasis = explicit \| pij_registry \| native_pane. Resolved {query, target, pij_id: Option&lt;String&gt;, pane: Option&lt;String&gt;, basis, conflicts: Vec&lt;ResolveConflict {basis, target}&gt;}., SessionStatus {schema_version, target, resolved: Option&lt;Resolved&gt;, model: ModelStatus {current: Option&lt;Fact&lt;String&gt;&gt;, current_at_ms: Option&lt;i64&gt;, pending_switch: Option&lt;ModelSwitchStatus {requested: String, at_ms: Option&lt;i64&gt;}&gt;, history: Vec&lt;ModelSpan {model, first_ms, last_ms, calls}&gt;}, context: ContextStatus {used_tokens: Option&lt;Fact&lt;u64&gt;&gt;, window_tokens: Option&lt;Fact&lt;u64&gt;&gt;, window_table: Option&lt;String&gt;, percent: Option&lt;f64&gt;, display: Option&lt;String&gt; ("250k of 1M (25%)")}, last_call: Option&lt;LastCall {at_ms, input, output, cache_read, cache_write_1h, cache_write_5m (all Option&lt;u64&gt;), ttl_bucket: Option&lt;Fact&lt;String&gt;&gt; ("1h"\|"5m"), cache_warm: Option&lt;Fact&lt;bool&gt;&gt;, stop_reason: Option&lt;String&gt;}&gt;, timeline: Timeline {created_ms: Option&lt;Fact&lt;i64&gt;&gt;, last_updated_ms: Option&lt;Fact&lt;i64&gt;&gt;, idle_seconds: Option&lt;u64&gt;}, turns: TurnStatus {total, last_hour_total, by_origin: BTreeMap&lt;String,u64&gt;, last_hour_by_origin: BTreeMap&lt;String,u64&gt;}, compaction: CompactionStatus {counts: Option&lt;CompactionCounts&gt;, last: Option&lt;CompactionSample&gt;}, calls: CallCounts {total, sidechain}, limits_seen: Vec&lt;LimitSeen {kind, at_ms, resets_at}&gt;, source: SourceStatus {bytes_read, pending_tail_bytes, reset: Option&lt;String&gt;}, unknown: Vec&lt;String&gt;}. CompactionCounts/CompactionSample are re-used from core::prep., trait SessionStatusApi: Send + Sync { fn status(&self, target: &StatusTarget, now_ms: i64) -&gt; Result&lt;SessionStatus, StatusFailure&gt;; } trait TargetResolver: Send + Sync { fn resolve(&self, query: &StatusQuery) -&gt; Result&lt;Resolved, StatusFailure&gt;; }, StatusFailure {kind: StatusFailureKind, message} with code() and recovery() per kind: UNI-STATUS-UNSUPPORTED-HARNESS, UNI-STATUS-TRANSCRIPT-NOT-FOUND, UNI-STATUS-READ, UNI-STATUS-PIJ-UNAVAILABLE, UNI-STATUS-PIJ-UNKNOWN-SEAT, UNI-STATUS-PIJ-NO-SESSION, UNI-STATUS-DEAD-BINDING, UNI-STATUS-PANE-NOT-FOUND. Messages never carry transcript content., SDK (crates/sdk/src/status.rs): StatusService::new(bindings: Vec&lt;PrepBinding&gt;) implements SessionStatusApi, plus the embedding op `fn status_incremental(&self, target: &StatusTarget, cursor: Option&lt;StatusCursor&gt;, now_ms: i64) -&gt; Result&lt;(SessionStatus, StatusCursor), StatusFailure&gt;`. StatusCursor is opaque, Clone + Send (PrepResume + stat identity/anchor + call/turn accumulators). Reads stop at the last complete record; shrink, identity change or anchor mismatch refolds cold and sets source.reset. Transcript default location for a (harness, session_id) with no path comes from the binding loader discovery under the catalogue root., Definitions: current model = latest main-chain non-synthetic call model; pending_switch = SessionFacts.last_model_switch newer than that call; used_tokens = latest_context.total (native); window = native when recorded else model-windows@1 table else unknown; percent only when both known; ttl_bucket from last call write split (derived); cache_warm = now - last call &lt; ttl (derived); last_updated = last_event_ms (native) else transcript mtime (mtime_fallback); Claude compaction count with zero markers = 0. |
